visualCharacteristics.purpose: flight search form (trip type, travellers, nonstop, origin/destination autocomplete, dates) that hands the search off to shop.lufthansa.com
traits: white search panel above the stage
options row (trip type select, traveller summary, nonstop checkbox) over a fields row
origin and destination inputs with a swap button between
date range and a primary submit button on one line at desktop

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value. Rows (all optional): Tabs | Flights; Trip types | Round trip, One way (first = round trip, second = one way; a missing second type gets the live one-way label); Default trip type | Round trip; Traveller label | Economy, 1 Traveller; Nonstop label | Nonstop only; From label | From; Default origin | Frankfurt (FRA) or FRA (omitted: the market default airport from /service/api/defaultAirport, like the live prefilled origin); Default destination | code; To label | To; Date label | Departure - Return (split at ' - ' into the two date labels); Date error | Please provide travel date(s); Submit label | Find flights; Where we fly | link; Cabin | E; Adults | 1. Overridable UI rows: Trip type label, Swap label, Departure label, Return label, One way date label, Return date error, Origin error, Destination error, Same airport error, No results label. UI strings: an authored row wins, then the live labels (/service/api/labels/flightmanager and common), then built-in English/German defaults

usage.description: Homepage and booking hub pages: the primary flight search above the stage.

reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged on every template and locale; change only the authored labels. Request builders and response mappers of the live API are in scripts/lh-api.js (suggestions/airports, labels, defaultAirport, catalogs/airportnames); typed terms without a live or recorded answer are matched against the airports known from the market recordings. The block keeps the label key map (LIVE_LABELS) and the shop handoff parameters (buildShopHandoffUrl).
